analysis: The method `follows` obtains an iterator via `iterator(someObject)`. It then enters a while loop that checks `it.hasNext()` before each call to `it.next()`. The loop only proceeds to call `next()` when `hasNext()` returns true, ensuring that there is always a next element. Therefore, the condition for throwing NoSuchElementException (iteration has no more elements) is avoided by the prior check.
remark: NoSuchElementException is avoided because the `hasNext()` check guarantees that `next()` is only called when there is at least one remaining element, preventing the condition for the exception.
